description: Measured roofline ceilings on the Jetson Orin Nano 8GB (25W power mode): STREAM-style bandwidth over shared LPDDR5 and dense cuBLAS GEMM throughput per precision, square and FLUX.2 klein 512² single-block shapes, plus a 60 s sustained BF16 GEMM. No model loaded; clocks not locked; run under jetson_memguard.sh.

datasheet.note: Super-mode figures (GPU 1020 MHz). 102 GB/s and 67 sparse INT8 TOPS are published; FP16/BF16 17 and dense INT8 33 follow the dense = sparse / 2 convention used in plot_roofline.py; TF32 (half the FP16 rate) and FP32 (1024 CUDA cores x 2 FLOP x 1.02 GHz) are derived, not published.
